notes.title: Fault - Broken Promises is now available to purchase!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/aef86927651024704d2b060e345c9dea56fee2fd.png

Hello everyone!

We’re overjoyed to announce the official release of Fault - Broken Promises, developed by Bicorn’s Forest! The game is available right now, with a special 20% off launch discount! Thank you so much for your support, we hope you will enjoy the story of Albel and Aiel!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2924660/Fault__Broken_Promises/

After losing in a duel of power and prestige, academy apprentice Albel has to brave the depths of the dungeon to save the beautiful swordswoman Aiel from falling into his rival’s hands. He promised her a future together… Can he keep it, or will their bond get broken?

notes.title: Simplified Chinese language added!
notes.content:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44021791/8e581d7e6d301061b05dadbeb0c07539dc45b28f.png

Hello everyone!

Today we're happy to announce that Deceived by the Host is now also available in Simplified Chinese!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2417260/Deceived_by_the_Host/

In addition to following the story of Hiroshi and Nanami in English and Japanese, you can now experience the full game in Simplified Chinese as well!

You can change the game's language by right-clicking on the game in your Steam games library, then select "Properties" and then pick any of the language options. You can currently select between English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

Here is the full list of updates:
- Added Simplified Chinese language.
- Fixed issues with some plugins.

If you’re a fellow fan of the kinks we represent, consider joining us on Discord and follow us on our Steam Publisher Page for all the latest news and games from Saikey Studios!
